proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7150 niktá documents replacement by MIA *nikka and explicitly gives Lahnda/Punjabi nikkā small, young, alongside Awan nik shortness. The bare regional nikā/nika masculine and niki feminine responses are analysed as substantivised young one, hence child/boy/girl. Source single-k spelling is retained; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. This does not assert that the Sanskrit adjective itself meant child. Exact response: nika child.
